instrument: Children's Automatic Thoughts Scale (CATS), 40-item child report
missing_policy: complete required per score, otherwise null; product convention
source_note: Subscale keys per the official 'Instructions for Scoring CATS' distributed with the form (Centre for Emotional Health, Macquarie University). Official clinical cut-offs printed on that sheet (Physical >=16, Social >=20, Personal Failure >=18, Hostile Intent >=23, Total >=70) are recorded here for research reference only and are NOT applied in product feedback: no bands, labels or risk tiers are derived from scores. Each subscale 0-40; total = sum of all 40 items (0-160).
